name: Convince Me!
description: Practice persuasive speaking by convincing classmates on random debate topics

intro.message:
Welcome to Convince Me!

You'll each get a random debate topic and 90 seconds to prepare a persuasive argument. Then you'll present to the class, and your classmates will rate how convincing you were.

Be creative, confident, and persuasive!

get-topics.instruction: Generate 20 unique debate topics for students in the class. Topics should be fun, age-appropriate for 15-year-olds, thought-provoking but not too serious. Mix silly and serious topics. Format as a JSON array of strings. Examples: 'Pizza should be classified as a sandwich', 'Schools should start at noon', 'Cats are better than dogs', 'Everyone should learn to juggle', 'Summer is overrated'. Make each topic different and engaging for teens.

assign-topics.message:
Topics assigned! Check your device to see what you'll be arguing.

You'll have 90 seconds to prepare your most persuasive argument.

Ready? Let's go!

prep-done.message:
Time's up! Arguments are in.

Now we'll hear from each person. After each speech, you'll rate how convincing they were.

Let's start!

intro-speaker.message:
Up next: {{_current.playerName}}!

Get ready to be convinced...

show-speech.message:
{{_current.playerName}} argues:

"{{_current.text}}"

Now rate how convincing this was!

conclusion.message:
Great persuasive speaking, everyone!

Remember: The most convincing speakers use specific examples, confident language, and connect with their audience.

Keep practicing!
